text: Maya: v2.1 is held — migration 0042 broke payment writes, we're rolling it back. Raj: so it's not the QA backlog? Maya: correct, the QA backlog (TICKET-130) is separate and was never on the critical path.

Maya: payments 500s started right after the deploy. We first guessed a load spike, but traffic was normal — the real cause is migration 0042 adding a non-null column with no default. Reverting now (COMMIT-a1b2). We should add a payment-write alarm.
Raj: the retry storm made INC-9 worse — fixed-interval retries hammered payments. Switching to exponential backoff with jitter and capping retries at 3.
Lena: I'm now the owner of notifications-service. Sam: yep, handed over; I'm on auth-service now. Please update the wiki, it's stale. Escalations go to the team-platform on-call.
Sam: v2.2 is blocked on the auth token-rotation endpoint (TICKET-145). It isn't done yet — realistically a couple of sprints out unless we pull in help.

Lena: notification delays (INC-12) looked like DB slowness at first, but it was a config refactor dropping worker concurrency 16->2 (COMMIT-g7h8). We had no queue-depth alarm, which is why it took so long to spot.
Priya: rolled back the ranking change, search latency back to normal. Unrelated to v2.x.
Tom: coffee machine on floor 3 is broken again. Anyone know who to ping?
